mapper.sql: r.id, r.review_id, r.input_revision, r.request_key, r.request_hash, r.status, r.failure_code, r.runner_instance_id, r.started_at, r.finished_at
mapper.select: SELECT input_revision FROM combination_review WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM combination_review_run r WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId} AND r.request_key = #{requestKey}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM combination_review_run WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'UNKNOWN')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO combination_review_run (review_id, input_revision, request_key, request_hash, status, input_json, runner_instance_id, started_at, queue_expires_at, next_publish_at) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{inputRevision}, #{requestKey}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{inputJson}, #{runnerInstanceId}, #{startedAt}, DATE_ADD(#{startedAt}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR), #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE combination_review_run SET evidence_json = #{evidenceJson} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND evidence_json IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO combination_review_run_source (run_id, document_index, raw_hash, raw_bytes) VALUES (#{runId}, #{documentIndex}, #{rawHash}, #{rawBytes})
mapper.select: SELECT s.run_id, s.document_index, s.raw_hash, s.raw_bytes FROM combination_review_run_source s INNER JOIN combination_review_run r ON r.id = s.run_id INNER JOIN combination_review c ON c.id = r.review_id WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId} AND r.id = #{runId} AND c.owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND s.document_index = #{documentIndex}
mapper.update: UPDATE combination_review_run r INNER JOIN combination_review c ON c.id = r.review_id INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = c.owner_account_id SET r.configuration_json = #{configurationJson} WHERE r.id = #{runId} AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.configuration_json IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.suspended_at IS NULL AND r.execution_started_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 20 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM account WHERE id = #{ownerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND suspended_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM combination_review_run r INNER JOIN combination_review c ON c.id = r.review_id WHERE c.owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND r.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'UNKNOWN')
SELECT FROM combination_review_run r WHERE r.id = #{runId}
mapper.update: UPDATE combination_review_run SET next_publish_at = DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND queue_expires_at > #{now} AND next_publish_at <= #{now}
UPDATE combination_review_run SET last_published_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{runId}

UPDATE combination_review_run r INNER JOIN combination_review c ON c.id = r.review_id INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = c.owner_account_id SET r.status = 'FAILED', r.failure_code = CASE WHEN a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.suspended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'ACCOUNT_INACTIVE' ELSE 'QUEUE_EXPIRED' END, r.finished_at = #{now} WHERE r.status = 'QUEUED' AND (r.queue_expires_at <= #{now} OR a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.suspended_at IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE combination_review_run SET status = 'UNKNOWN', failure_code = 'RUN_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN', finished_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND COALESCE(execution_started_at, started_at) <= DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 20 MINUTE)
